before_conditions: The TrailsRouter contract has an injectAndCall() function (and other router functions such as injectSweepAndCall) that lack the onlyDelegatecall modifier.
The project invariant states that Router/RouterShim functions execute only via delegatecall from a Sequence v3 wallet context, and any direct call must revert via onlyDelegatecall.
The test suite intentionally calls these functions directly and expects them to succeed, and no tests enforce or expect delegatecall-only behavior.
required_property: All Router/RouterShim functions must execute only via delegatecall from a Sequence v3 wallet context, and any direct call must revert via the onlyDelegatecall modifier, protecting the intended execution context and storage of the Sequence v3 wallet.
bad_outcome: Directly calling injectAndCall (or other functions lacking onlyDelegatecall) succeeds instead of reverting, causing the function to read/write from the Router contract's own storage rather than the Sequence wallet storage, breaking the expected execution context; alternatively, if direct calls are intended, the documentation is misleading and creates incorrect assumptions for auditors and integrators.
